# Roamify eSIM API — Best eSIM API for Resellers, Travel Apps & White-Label eSIM Platforms

> Roamify offers the best eSIM API for travel apps, eSIM resellers, B2B platforms, MVNOs, and white-label eSIM solutions. Instantly provision, activate, and manage eSIMs across 200+ countries with a simple REST API. Supports eSIM wholesale purchasing, real-time eSIM activation, data top-ups, affiliate commission tracking, live exchange rates, and event-driven webhook notifications. Trusted by global eSIM resellers and travel tech companies. Authentication uses long-lived Bearer tokens from the Roamify Partner Portal.

Environments:
- Development: https://api-dev.getroamify.com
- Production: https://api.getroamify.com

All requests require the `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header and `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.getroamify.com/): Roamify eSIM API overview — best eSIM API for travel apps, eSIM resellers, and white-label eSIM platforms with quick-start integration guide
- [Authentication](https://docs.getroamify.com/authentication/): eSIM API authentication — long-lived Bearer token, no refresh required; retrieve API key from Roamify Partner Portal
- [About Roamify eSIM API](https://docs.getroamify.com/about/): Roamify eSIM API features — buy eSIMs programmatically, manage eSIM profiles, check prepaid balance, top-up data, view transaction history
- [Health Check](https://docs.getroamify.com/health/): GET /api/health — check Roamify eSIM API uptime and availability; monitor service status for production integrations

## eSIMs Module — Core eSIM API Endpoints

- [eSIM API Overview](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/overview/): End-to-end eSIM integration guide — purchase eSIM data plans, activate eSIM profiles, manage usage, and top-up; ideal for travel eSIM apps and eSIM reseller platforms
- [eSIM Countries](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/countries/): GET /api/esim/countries — list 200+ countries with eSIM coverage; global eSIM support for travel, international roaming, and local eSIM data plans
- [eSIM Packages](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/packages/): GET /api/esim/packages — browse local eSIM plans, regional eSIM plans, and global eSIM data packages; filter by country, geography, days, GBs, unlimited eSIM, or packageId
- [eSIM Orders](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/orders/): POST /api/esim/order — place eSIM wholesale orders, create eSIM top-up orders, instant eSIM orders, and retrieve order history for eSIM resellers
- [eSIM Management](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/esims/): POST /api/esim/apply — generate and activate eSIM profiles; get eSIM data usage, compatible top-up packages, eSIM package history, retrieve eSIM by ICCID or esimId, and send SMS messages to eSIM profiles
- [Send SMS to eSIM](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/esims/): POST /api/esim/sms — send an SMS to a specific eSIM using ICCID and message body
- [eSIM Sharing Link](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/esims-link/): POST /api/esim/link — generate branded eSIM installation links for customers; includes access code and pre-built WhatsApp share URL for eSIM distribution
- [eSIM Lifecycle Events](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/events/): GET /api/esim/event — retrieve complete eSIM lifecycle history (activation, usage, expiry) by ICCID, esimId, or custom referenceId; useful for eSIM support teams
- [eSIM Compatible Devices](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/compatible-devices/): GET /api/compatible-devices — list all eSIM-compatible smartphones, tablets, and wearables to help customers check eSIM device compatibility
- [Partner Account Balance](https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/balance/): GET /api/balance — retrieve real-time prepaid wallet balance for eSIM wholesale and eSIM reseller accounts

## Webhooks Module — Real-Time eSIM Event Notifications

- [Webhooks Overview](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/overview/): Roamify webhook integration guide — real-time eSIM event notifications for resellers; covers HTTPS requirements, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and best practices for reliable eSIM event processing
- [Webhook Signature Verification](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/verification/): Secure webhook verification using X-Roamify-Signature HMAC-SHA256 signing; code examples in JavaScript, PHP, and Python to authenticate eSIM webhook events
- [eSIM Status Change Events](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/esim-status/): Real-time webhook notifications for eSIM status changes — activated, deactivated, suspended, expired; ideal for automating eSIM lifecycle management
- [eSIM Data Usage Events](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/esim-usage/): Real-time eSIM data usage webhook — receive usage alerts at configurable thresholds; enables proactive top-up prompts and low-data warnings for travel eSIM apps
- [Partner Balance Events](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/partner-balance/): Webhook alerts for eSIM reseller account balance — low_balance, insufficient_balance, and top_up events to prevent service interruptions
- [Affiliate Order Events](https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/affiliate-orders/): Webhook notifications for eSIM affiliate sales — receive instant order confirmation events when customers buy through your referral links

## Affiliate Module — eSIM Affiliate & Referral API

- [eSIM Affiliate Program Overview](https://docs.getroamify.com/affiliate/overview/): Roamify eSIM affiliate API — earn commissions on every eSIM sale; onboarding guide, referral link tracking, and commission monitoring for eSIM affiliate marketers and travel content creators
- [eSIM Affiliate Links](https://docs.getroamify.com/affiliate/affiliate-links/): GET /api/esim/{unique-name}/packages — fetch your eSIM packages with embedded affiliate referral links; track eSIM sales by unique partner identifier

## Exchange Rates — Real-Time Currency Conversion API

- [Exchange Rates Overview](https://docs.getroamify.com/exchange-rates/overview/): Roamify real-time currency exchange rates API — 100+ currencies, live rates, historical rates, and time-series data; ideal for eSIM pricing in local currencies for global travel apps
- [Supported Currencies](https://docs.getroamify.com/exchange-rates/get-currencies/): GET /api/currencies — list all 100+ supported fiat currencies for international eSIM pricing and currency conversion
- [Get Exchange Rates](https://docs.getroamify.com/exchange-rates/get-exchange-rates/): GET /api/rates — latest exchange rates, historical currency rates (point-in-time with datetime), and time-series currency data (from+to+interval) for eSIM price localization
